Configure iTRAK 5.0 - Support for iTRAK Device Handler v5.0 ============================================================ Instruction Overview: ----- Configure the iTRAK Device Handler. The method applies a configuration based on mover count, polarity, offset and track shape.
Instruction Execution: ----- Edge
Supplemental Descriptions: ----- Sts_ERR Enumeration: Error codes Descirption 1002 Device Handler is faulted. Clear faults to apply commands. 1003 Device Handler is not in connected state 1004 Test mode Configuration Fault, configure all axis in same mode 1005 Device is energized. Power down and reapply the method 1010 Inp_ActiveMovers exceed the maximum number of movers supported by the Device Handler configuration. Generate a new project with the appropriate number of movers. 1011 Inp_PositionOffset is out of bounds. The absolute value of the position offset has exceeded the track length Select an offset -track length <= PositionOffset <= track length
Revision Notes: ----- 5.0 - Support for iTRAK Device Handler v5.0 4.0 - Renamed Add-On Instruction. Support for iTRAK57xx Device Handler 4.0 1.1 - Event fields match Machine Builder standards order 1.0 - First Release
